approval_text: keep all nine labels and select v1
reason: V1 has the strongest observed development TPR and TNR of v0/v1/v2; both allowed revisions have been used. No required metric threshold was applied.
known_development_limitation: V1 missed 5 of 12 human Fail cases; dev TNR 58.33% with 95% Wilson interval 31.95–80.67%.

human_use_decision.decision: Do not use this judge for unattended failure detection.
human_use_decision.reason: On the held-out test it detected only 3 of 12 human failures (TNR 25%; 95% Wilson CI 8.89–53.23%).
